name: Azraq
summary:
YOUR ISLAND. YOUR PATH. YOUR LEGEND.

AZRAQ is a fantasy VR MMORPG where the world grows through your actions. Build with your hands, master physical combat and descend into dangerous depths to bring home what your island needs to thrive.

BUILD AN ISLAND THAT EVOLVES
Gather resources, place construction pieces yourself and unlock new land. Choose your priorities: expand your home, forge metal weapons, craft bows and staffs, make armor or brew potions in your herbalist garden. Every island tells a different
